# GPTCode

> GPTCode is an open-source coding agent for repository-native, multi-model engineering workflows with executable verification.

GPTCode treats language models as interchangeable reasoning engines, repositories as the source of constraints, and deterministic checks as the source of truth.

## Primary resources

- [Overview]({{ site.url }}{{ '/' | relative_url }}): Product thesis, real terminal workflow, architecture, and installation.
- [Documentation]({{ site.url }}{{ '/reference/commands' | relative_url }}): Commands and usage.
- [Skills]({{ site.url }}{{ '/skills' | relative_url }}): Version-controlled engineering instructions.
- [Essays]({{ site.url }}{{ '/blog' | relative_url }}): Writing about reliable AI-assisted software engineering.
- [Source](https://github.com/jadercorrea/gptcode): MIT-licensed Go implementation.

## Core thesis

- Models generate possibilities.
- Repositories define constraints.
- Verification establishes truth.
- The workflow is the source of truth; models are interchangeable execution engines.

## Creator

Created by [Jader Correa](https://jader-correa.com), a principal engineer building AI agents, developer tools, and distributed systems.
